topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 81 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 10 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 20 common project-authored base contract(s) (peripheryimmutablestate, poolinitializer, liquiditymanagement). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
